Please carry a valid photo ID and your registration confirmation (digital or printed). All board games, components, and score sheets will be provided by the organisers.
Participants should report at least 20 minutes before their first scheduled match. Late arrivals may receive penalties or forfeit their match.

items.q: Can I leave the venue between rounds?
items.a: Yes, but ensure you return before your next scheduled match. Missing your match may result in a forfeit.
All decisions made by the tournament organisers and judges are final.
Players will receive their match schedule before the tournament begins. Please check the schedule board regularly for updates.
Each game follows its official victory conditions. Rankings are determined by the tournament format announced before the event.

items.q: What happens in case of a tie?
items.a: Tie-break procedures vary by game and will follow the official rulebook or tournament-specific guidelines announced by the organisers.

items.q: What if a rules dispute occurs?
items.a: Pause the game immediately and call a tournament judge. Do not continue play until the ruling has been made.
Once new information has been revealed or another player has acted, moves cannot be taken back unless permitted by a judge.
Phones should remain on silent mode. Using phones for strategy discussions or outside assistance during a match is prohibited.
Players are expected to understand the basic rules of the games they have registered for and be ready to play when called.

items.q: Can I receive help during a match?
items.a: No. Coaching, strategy advice, or assistance from spectators or other participants is not permitted.

items.q: How should game components be handled?
items.a: Please treat all game components with care. Any intentional damage or misuse may result in penalties.

items.q: What if I need to leave during a match?
items.a: Inform the table judge or organiser before leaving. Excessive delays may result in penalties depending on the situation.
Players should demonstrate honesty, fairness, respect, and good sportsmanship throughout the tournament.

items.q: How should players interact with opponents?
items.a: Treat every participant respectfully regardless of experience or results. Unsporting behaviour will not be tolerated.
Yes, but celebrations should remain respectful and should not disturb other ongoing matches.

The player's remaining matches will be forfeited and entry fees will not be refunded unless otherwise decided by the organisers.

items.q: Can I change my registered game?
items.a: Game changes are permitted only until the registration deadline and are subject to slot availability.
Yes, provided they remain silent, do not interfere with play, and follow organiser instructions.

items.q: Will food and drinks be available?
items.a: Food and beverages may be available at the venue. Please keep them away from game tables and components.

items.q: Can I take photos or videos?
items.a: Yes, provided they do not disturb players or reveal hidden game information during active matches.

items.q: Who should I contact if I have questions?
items.a: Visit the tournament help desk or speak to any event volunteer or organiser during the event.
